name: Gà nướng lu
summary: Chicken roasted in a lu, listed beside the lá é hotpot at one Chu Văn An door.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note says Lẩu gà lá é 668 also serves gà nướng lu.
howToEat: The note names the dish and does not describe the roast. A price for this plate alone is Check on arrival.
where: Lẩu gà lá é 668, 2B Chu Văn An. Hours are Check on arrival.
priceBand: Check on arrival. The same note prints 20,000–100,000 VND a person for the hotpot at this door, not for the roast.
seoDescription: Chicken roasted in a lu, listed beside the lá é hotpot at one Chu Văn An door.
